item.text: {"decision":"Adopt the assessor proposal with evidence limits preserved. New incident records answer motion and hydraulic requests, partially narrow execution/isolation and inspection requests, and support two incident conditions: C17/V17 support-fluid loss produced about 40 mm relative yoke withdrawal, exceeding the 30 mm primary seating engagement, and no independent positive yoke block was present. The full fall mechanism remains unresolved because the keeper-bypass lateral offset/rotation/deformation path was occluded or unmeasured. WP-031 omission is now supported as contributing to the unblocked configuration in the limited sense that the procedure omitted a positive restraint/retention-envelope check and the event configuration showed no block; the origin/reason for the omission remains not supplied.","operations":[{"action":"revise","expected_version":3,"replaces":null,"reason":"D07 answers the requested motion fields within stated limits. D07.S01 identifies CAM-3 as continuous from 13:00:00 to 13:24:10 with plant-clock indexing and surveyed vertical references. D07.S02 reports yoke downward displacement 40 +/- 1 mm and carrier downward displacement 0 +/- 1 mm from 13:00:00 to 13:24:00, with seated start visible and post/spreader contact visible during the interval; using D02.S04 convention, relative withdrawal is 40 +/- 2 mm by interval arithmetic. D07.S03 reports carrier downward travel into the pit began at 13:24:03, but the keeper interface and lateral offset were occluded. D07.S04 provides limited negative evidence of no direct crane/load contact visible within the fully covered carrier envelope from 13:00 to 13:24:03, while not excluding earlier disturbance or contact outside that envelope. Reopening condition: a revised or additional synchronized motion source with lateral/rotation visibility, keeper-interface visibility, or broader contact coverage.","record":{"id":"R_R3MotionRecord","kind":"request","scope_key":"r3_motion_record_2024-10-14_event_window","claim":"Obtain and assess retained motion evidence to determine yoke/carrier movement timing, relative withdrawal, and possible interference during the R3 beam fall event.","status":"answered","sources":["D01","D02","D04","D07","D15"],"depends_on":["N_FocalEvent_R3BeamFall"],"from_ids":[],"to_id":null,"mode":null,"asset":"R3 delivery carrier beam and CB-3/YK-3 raised assembly","window":"14 October 2024 outage, interval before and at 13:24 event","fields":["time-position trace for yoke YK-3 and carrier beam","relative vertical withdrawal calculation inputs","evidence of mill post or spreader interference timing"]}} ,{"action":"revise","expected_version":3,"replaces":null,"reason":"D08, D09, and D05 answer the hydraulic/isolation fields within stated limits. D08.S01 verifies C17/V17 identity and 13:00:00-13:24:00 synchronization with CAM-3. D08.S02 reports V17 CLOSED indication remained 1, 0.400 +/- 0.010 L left the C17 chamber through V17, external loss was below 0.002 L, no alternate return route was found, and instrument checks passed. With D02.S02/D08.S03 effective area 100 cm2 = 0.01 m2, 0.400 L = 0.000400 m3 gives 0.000400/0.01 = 0.040 m = 40 mm yoke travel; 0.010 L/0.01 m2 gives +/- 1 mm uncertainty. D05.S01 reports electrical isolation complete and V17 handle CLOSED at 13:00, but not valve tightness. D09.S01-S03 later bench testing of removed V17 found CLOSED indication with 17 +/- 2 mL/min reverse leakage and no external body leak; custody supports identity, but the later test alone does not timestamp the defect or establish incident leakage rate. Reopening condition: corrected tag identity, revised synchronized hydraulic export, or new evidence of an alternate route, external loss, or different event-window leakage behavior.","record":{"id":"R_R3HydraulicRecords","kind":"request","scope_key":"r3_c17_v17_hydraulic_records_2024-10-14_event_window","claim":"Obtain and assess retained hydraulic evidence for C17/V17 to determine support-chamber pressure/fluid retention, valve status, leakage, and alternate return-path conditions during the R3 raised-assembly event.","status":"answered","sources":["D01","D02","D04","D05","D08","D09","D15"],"depends_on":["N_FocalEvent_R3BeamFall"],"from_ids":[],"to_id":null,"mode":null,"asset":"R3 CB-3/YK-3 raised balance assembly C17 support chamber and V17 return-isolation valve","window":"14 October 2024 outage, interval before and at 13:24 event","fields":["C17 support-chamber pressure or position-related hydraulic data","V17 handle or closed-limit status with timestamps","V17 seat-leakage or chamber-to-return leakage measurements","external leakage and alternate return-path monitoring","motor or pump supply isolation timing"]}} ,{"action":"revise","expected_version":3,"replaces":null,"reason":"D05 answers actual configuration/isolation fields in part, while USER_5258a84a5f5b establishes a supplied-package boundary for remaining execution/signoff and authorization/reason fields. D05.S01 reports backup rolls removed at 12:52, balance raised at 12:57, electrical isolation complete at 13:00, and V17 handle CLOSED at 13:00, but expressly not valve tightness. D05.S02 reports a 13:00 configuration photograph reviewed against block locations showed no independent positive block under YK-3 and carrier contact with the mill post/spreader, but did not resolve keeper overlap. D05.S03 reports no loaded hold test, chamber-volume test, or keeper-envelope check before work began, while not proving deliberate noncompliance or defect origin. USER_5258a84a5f5b states the supplied package contains no additional record answering completed WP-031 steps/signoffs or authorization/reason for any omitted restraint or retention-envelope verification, and that this is a supplied-package limit rather than proof no historical activity or record ever existed. Remaining uncovered fields are narrowed to those two unavailable-in-package items. Reopening condition: production of completed WP-031 forms/signoff logs, authorization/deviation/risk-assessment records, or a custodian answer from another record route.","record":{"id":"R_R3ExecutionIsolation","kind":"request","scope_key":"r3_wp031_execution_isolation_records_2024-10-14","claim":"Obtain and assess work-package execution and isolation evidence to determine actual restraint, isolation, authorization, and compliance conditions for WP-031 during the R3 event.","status":"partial","sources":["D01","D02","D04","D05","D15","USER_5258a84a5f5b"],"depends_on":["N_FocalEvent_R3BeamFall"],"from_ids":[],"to_id":null,"mode":null,"asset":"R3 raised balance assembly during WP-031 stripper-box changeout","window":"14 October 2024 outage before and at 13:24 event","fields":["completed WP-031 steps and signoffs","authorization and reason for any omitted restraint or retention-envelope verification"]}} ,{"action":"revise","expected_version":3,"replaces":null,"reason":"D14 and D10 add inspection/engineering coverage but leave the dynamic keeper-bypass question partly unanswered. D14.S01 reports CB-3/YK-3 were photographed after recovery, keeper fasteners remained installed, the plate remained attached, and the full plate/fasteners showed no gross separation or fracture; it does not establish dynamic overlap during release. D14.S02 reports witness marks on carrier and mill post/spreader contact surfaces consistent with contact but not dating contact onset or exact load. D14.S03 says no material record supports a fatigue-fracture explanation of a keeper bolt in that examination, while unmeasured deformation and off-center release path remain separate. D10.S02 reports centered, seated post-event keeper overlap of 8 +/- 1 mm and says simple vertical passage over the yoke is not possible under rigid centered seated geometry, but D10.S03 states incident lateral offset and release rotation were not measured and no approved off-center dynamic retention envelope is available. Remaining fields are narrowed to unmeasured deformation and incident offset/rotation/dynamic-path evidence. Reopening condition: time-relevant lateral/rotation measurement, validated dynamic retention-envelope analysis, additional measurements/NDE for deformation, or inspection evidence dating/loading the contact marks.","record":{"id":"R_R3InspectionPhotos","kind":"request","scope_key":"r3_recovered_assembly_inspection_photos_measurements_2024-10-14","claim":"Obtain and assess inspection photographs and measurements to document recovered component condition, keeper/seating geometry, lateral offset indicators, and impact/contact evidence relevant to the R3 beam release path.","status":"partial","sources":["D01","D02","D04","D10","D14","D15"],"depends_on":["N_FocalEvent_R3BeamFall"],"from_ids":[],"to_id":null,"mode":null,"asset":"R3 recovered carrier beam, yoke YK-3, keeper plate, sled, scaffold, and adjacent mill-post/spreader contact areas","window":"post-event recovery/inspection following 13:24 event on 14 October 2024, with preservation history if available","fields":["beam and yoke deformation measurement evidence beyond no-gross-fracture inspection","incident lateral offset, release rotation, or validated off-center dynamic retention-envelope evidence","dating and load significance of carrier, mill post, or spreader witness/contact marks"]}} ,{"action":"revise","expected_version":1,"replaces":null,"reason":"The occurrence portion of the claim is now supported. D08.S01-S03 provide event-window C17/V17 measurement identity and show 0.400 +/- 0.010 L leaving the C17 chamber through V17 despite V17 CLOSED indication. Using D02.S02/D08.S03 effective support area 100 cm2 = 0.01 m2 and 1:1 cylinder-to-yoke travel, volume/area gives 0.000400 m3 / 0.01 m2 = 0.040 m = 40 mm yoke downward travel, +/- 1 mm from volume uncertainty. D07.S02 independently measures yoke downward displacement 40 +/- 1 mm and carrier downward displacement 0 +/- 1 mm over the same 13:00-13:24 interval, so relative withdrawal is 40 +/- 2 mm by interval arithmetic, with lower bound 38 mm > D02.S05's 30 mm primary seating engagement. D09.S02-S03 later V17 bench leakage is compatible with the incident route but is not needed to quantify event withdrawal and does not timestamp contamination. This supports hydraulic support-fluid loss and sufficient relative withdrawal; it does not establish keeper bypass or the full fall mechanism.","record":{"id":"N_R3HydraulicWithdrawalUnresolved","kind":"node","scope_key":"r3_event_hydraulic_loss_and_relative_withdrawal_sufficiency","claim":"During the R3 event, C17/V17 hydraulic support-fluid loss produced yoke/carrier relative vertical withdrawal sufficient to eliminate the 30 mm primary seating engagement.","status":"supported","sources":["D02","D07","D08","D09"],"depends_on":["R_R3HydraulicRecords","R_R3MotionRecord"],"from_ids":[],"to_id":null,"mode":null,"asset":null,"window":null,"fields":[]}} ,{"action":"revise","expected_version":1,"replaces":null,"reason":"New evidence still does not resolve the incident keeper-bypass dynamic path. D02.S05 requires separate evidence of lateral offset and dynamic path beyond primary seating loss. D07.S03 reports release at 13:24:03 but says the keeper-to-yoke interface and lateral offset were occluded, so the clip cannot distinguish transient offset, rotation, or local deformation as the keeper-bypass mechanism. D10.S02 shows centered seated overlap of 8 +/- 1 mm and no simple vertical passage under rigid centered seated geometry, but D10.S03 says incident lateral offset and release rotation are not measured and an approved off-center dynamic retention envelope is unavailable. D14.S01 says recovery inspection does not establish dynamic overlap during release, and D14.S03 leaves unmeasured deformation/off-center path as separate questions. Therefore the specific bypass path remains unresolved, not refuted, because the carrier did release but the required offset/rotation/deformation mechanism is unmeasured.","record":{"id":"N_R3KeeperBypassUnresolved","kind":"node","scope_key":"r3_keeper_bypass_lateral_offset_dynamic_path_event","claim":"During the R3 event, the carrier beam followed a lateral offset and dynamic path that bypassed keeper retention after any loss of primary seating engagement.","status":"unresolved","sources":["D02","D07","D10","D14","D15"],"depends_on":["R_R3InspectionPhotos","R_R3MotionRecord"],"from_ids":[],"to_id":null,"mode":null,"asset":null,"window":null,"fields":[]}} ,{"action":"revise","expected_version":1,"replaces":null,"reason":"Actual absence of positive mechanical restraint is now supported within the event configuration. D05.S02 reports a 13:00 configuration photograph reviewed against block locations showed no independent positive block under YK-3. D08.S03 states no independent block was present within the specified 13:00-13:24 C17/V17 boundary/model. D02.S06 distinguishes positive mechanical restraint from electrical isolation and hydraulic handle position. This supports absence of a positive yoke block or equivalent positive mechanical restraint during the event interval; it does not establish why the block was absent or by itself prove keeper bypass.","record":{"id":"N_R3ActualBlockAbsentUnresolved","kind":"node","scope_key":"r3_actual_positive_yoke_block_absence_event_window","claim":"At the R3 event, no positive yoke block or equivalent positive mechanical restraint was actually present to restrain the raised assembly.","status":"supported","sources":["D02","D05","D08"],"depends_on":["R_R3ExecutionIsolation"],"from_ids":[],"to_id":null,"mode":null,"asset":null,"window":null,"fields":[]}} ,{"action":"revise","expected_version":1,"replaces":null,"reason":"The joint physical mechanism remains unresolved because only two of its required incident conditions are now supported. D07 and D08 support hydraulic fluid loss and 40 +/- 2 mm relative withdrawal, exceeding the 30 mm primary seating engagement. D05 and D08 support no independent positive block. D07.S03, D10.S03, and D14.S01-S03 leave the keeper-bypass lateral offset/rotation/deformation path unresolved: the interface was occluded, incident offset/rotation were not measured, and no dynamic retention envelope is available. D01 reports the fall but not its release mechanism. Because the edge requires all three premises jointly, unresolved keeper bypass prevents support for the full causal contribution, even though hydraulic withdrawal and lack of positive block remain compatible contributors.","record":{"id":"E_R3HydraulicWithdrawalKeeperBypassToFall","kind":"edge","scope_key":"r3_joint_hydraulic_withdrawal_keeper_bypass_no_block_caused_fall","claim":"Hydraulic support loss with sufficient relative yoke withdrawal, keeper-bypass dynamic path, and absence of positive mechanical restraint jointly caused or allowed the R3 delivery carrier beam fall.","status":"unresolved","sources":["D01","D02","D05","D07","D08","D10","D14","D15"],"depends_on":[],"from_ids":["N_R3HydraulicWithdrawalUnresolved","N_R3KeeperBypassUnresolved","N_R3ActualBlockAbsentUnresolved"],"to_id":"N_FocalEvent_R3BeamFall","mode":"all","asset":null,"window":null,"fields":[]}} ,{"action":"revise","expected_version":1,"replaces":null,"reason":"The limited causal contribution from the WP-031 text omission to actual absence of positive restraint is now supported. D04.S01 establishes the task text called for electrical supply isolation and hydraulic valve closure but had no positive yoke block or off-center retention-envelope verification instruction. D05.S02 supplies actual configuration evidence: the 13:00 photograph showed no independent positive block under YK-3. D05.S03 reports no loaded hold test, chamber-volume test, or keeper-envelope check was recorded before work began. USER_5258a84a5f5b and D04.S03 preserve the remaining limit: completed step/signoff records and authorization/reason for omission are not supplied, so this does not explain why the procedure omitted the step or prove deliberate noncompliance. Within that scope, the procedure omission contributed to the unblocked configuration by not requiring the missing positive restraint/verification.","record":{"id":"E_WP031OmissionToBlockAbsence","kind":"edge","scope_key":"wp031_no_block_instruction_contributed_to_actual_no_positive_block","claim":"WP-031's lack of a positive-yoke-block or retention-envelope-verification instruction contributed to the actual absence of positive mechanical restraint during the R3 event.","status":"supported","sources":["D04","D05","USER_5258a84a5f5b"],"depends_on":[],"from_ids":["N_WP031NoBlockRetentionInstruction"],"to_id":"N_R3ActualBlockAbsentUnresolved","mode":"all","asset":null,"window":null,"fields":[]}}],"next_work":[{"kind":"specialist","tag":"mechanical_retention","focus":"Assess the remaining keeper-bypass uncertainty using D07/D10/D14: distinguish what can be inferred from primary seating loss and observed release versus what still requires lateral offset, rotation, deformation, or a validated dynamic retention envelope.","target_ids":["N_R3KeeperBypassUnresolved","E_R3HydraulicWithdrawalKeeperBypassToFall"]},{"kind":"specialist","tag":"hydraulic_upstream","focus":"Evaluate upstream causes and evidence limits for the supported C17/V17 support-fluid loss, including V17 closed indication versus leakage, later seat contamination, and what is or is not timestamped by D08/D09.","target_ids":["N_R3HydraulicWithdrawalUnresolved"]},{"kind":"specialist","tag":"work_control_upstream","focus":"Evaluate upstream work-control contribution within current evidence limits: WP-031 omission, no block/no hold or keeper-envelope check in D05, and the supplied-package boundary for signoff and authorization/reason records.","target_ids":["E_WP031OmissionToBlockAbsence","N_WP031NoBlockRetentionInstruction"]}],"upstream_dispositions":[],"disposition":"continue"}
